description: This file defines an abstract class MAX_Plugin_Common that provides common methods and interface for plugin classes in the Revive Adserver project, including configuration handling, caching, cache cleaning, and translation.

classes.name: MAX_Plugin_Common
classes.description: An abstract class defining common methods and interface for plugin classes, including configuration retrieval, cache management, and translation.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Reads the specific plugin configuration file, returning configuration data as an array.

methods.name: getConfigFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the plugin configuration file.

methods.name: getCacheById
methods.description: Retrieves cache data by ID, optionally testing cache validity.

methods.name: saveCache
methods.description: Saves data into a cache file with a specified ID.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Clears cache based on the specified mode.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a string using the module/package translation file.
